source(output(
		CID as integer,
		PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '[PR_PHARMACY_90_DAY_FAX]
		@INPUT_FILE_NAME =',
	schemaName: '[APP_CPLS]',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		CID as integer,
		PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CID,PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID,TRANSFER_STATUS FROM APP_CPLS.PHARMACY_CREATE_TASK WITH(NOLOCK) WHERE TRANSFER_STATUS=\'P\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPCIDAddedforTaskLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource derive(TRANSFER_STATUS = toString('P')) ~> TransferStatus
OLEDBSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCountAGGREGATE
TransferStatus,LKPCIDAddedforTaskLKPTABLE lookup(OLEDBSource@PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID == LKPCIDAddedforTaskLKPTABLE@PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID && TransferStatus@TRANSFER_STATUS == LKPCIDAddedforTaskLKPTABLE@TRANSFER_STATUS && OLEDBSource@CID == LKPCIDAddedforTaskLKPTABLE@CID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPCIDAddedforTask
RowCountAGGREGATE sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
LKPCIDAddedforTask select(mapColumn(
		TRANSFER_STATUS = TransferStatus@TRANSFER_STATUS,
		CID = OLEDBSource@CID,
		PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID = OLEDBSource@PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> LKPCIDAddedforTaskSelect
LKPCIDAddedforTaskSelect filter(!isMatch()) ~> FilterLKPCIDAddedforTask
FilterLKPCIDAddedforTask sink(input(
		PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID as integer,
		TRANSFER_STATUS as string,
		CID as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		PHARMACY_DATA_LOAD_ID,
		TRANSFER_STATUS,
		CID)) ~> OLEDBDestination
